source_sites.operation: incomplete path kill(-child, SIGKILL) before waitpid

finding.trigger: Permitted SIGCHLD=SIG_IGN or SA_NOCLDWAIT may automatically reap an exited engine.
finding.source_behavior: The incomplete path sends a raw negative numeric PGID before checking waitpid.
finding.risk: After the old process group ceases to exist, that numeric identifier can name another group lifetime.
finding.identity_distinction: An immutable old child birth token and copied PID value do not establish the current target lifetime of a later kill(-pid, SIGKILL).

proof_boundary.proved_components: The raw C source and native operand/row bridge retain the exact negative group bits, signal9, actual optional observation and separate committed native product.
proof_boundary.not_proved: Current signal target belongs to the original engine birth or its owned descendants.
proof_boundary.not_assumed: SIGCHLD disposition is fixed; callbacks cannot change permitted signal configuration; the numeric PID/PGID is never reused.
proof_boundary.m5_2_consumers: Any M5.2 statement consuming current-lifetime cancellation ownership must retain this open producer. Raw source/byte provenance receipts do not claim it.

required_resolution: Implement a lifetime-safe signaling/cleanup route and prove its actual current target. Do not silently strengthen the caller profile or substitute an old birth receipt.
evidence_kind: Static actual-source and contract review. No hostile host experiment or reproducer was run.
